options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Ending Goal(s)
options.doc: Goal(s) required in order to finish.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
This controls death link enablement.
If you game over, other players with death link enabled will also game over, and vice versa.

options.name: Include Friendly Fire Locations
options.doc:
This controls whether locations specific to attacking non-hostile
characters and potential recruits are included. This includes all merchants, Spine, and Marc-André.

options.name: Include Superbosses
options.doc:
Includes locations for defeating superbosses 
(Honko, Baby Teeth Day 9, Swordmaster Comatus, KOTD, Slime Hydra, Drowning, Godmutt, Boiler Beast, and Furnace).
options.doc_fr: Comprend les emplacements pour vaincre les superbesosses (Honko, Baby Deeth Jour 9, Swordmaster Comatus, KOTD, Slime Hydra, Drowning, Godmutt, Boiler Beast et Furnace).

options.name: Casanova Mode
options.doc:
When checked, Casanova mode will be activated, and locations added for each possible kiss.
Note: kiss locations will always be included if a Casanova mode goal is selected, regardless of this option's setting.

options.name: Include Rusty Crown Locations
options.doc: This controls whether locations specific to interacting with non-hostile rats are randomized.

options.name: Include Rat Friendly Fire Locations
options.doc:
This controls whether locations specific to attacking rats that become non-hostile
when wearing the rusty crown are included.

options.name: Include Nestor and Rafta's Quest
options.doc: This controls whether locations specific to the Nestor and Rafta romance quest are randomized.

options.name: Include the Spider's Recruitment Quest
options.doc: This controls whether locations specific to the Spider recruitment quest are randomized.

choices.label: Include Large Shades And Spider And Crawling Shade

options.name: Include Mask Offering Locations
options.doc:
When checked, areas specific to the
Mask ending will be randomized: Glitch world, floor 4, the basement pit,
and the landlord's hidden room.

options.name: Include Long Roommate Sidequests
options.doc:
When checked, items from roommate quests that involve escorting companions to their own apartments are
randomized: Dan, Hellen, and Leigh's quests.

options.name: Include Video Game Skill Locations
options.doc: This controls whether the skills given by completing each of the video games are randomized.

options.name: Include Door Encounter Locations
options.doc: Randomize items from door encounters, including merchants. Default true.

options.name: Allow Killing Mutt and Eugene
options.doc: This controls whether players are allowed to kill Eugene or Mutt to get their stuff. Default false

options.name: Include Test Armor/Test Swords
options.doc: Adds Test Armor and Test Swords to the item pool. These items are incredibly busted; they make most fights trivial.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute l'armure d'essai et les épées d'essai au pool d'articles. Ces objets sont incroyablement cassés; ils rendent la plupart des combats triviaux.

options.name: Include Final True Ending Equipment
options.doc: Adds the equipment wielded by the cast of Massacre Princess to the item pool. These items are unbalanced; they make most fights easier.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute l'équipement manié par le plâtre de Massacre Princesse à la piscine de l'article. Ces éléments sont déséquilibrés; ils facilitent la plupart des combats.

options.name: Randomize Player Arms
options.doc: Adds the player character's arms to the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute les bras du personnage au pool de l'article.

options.name: Include Traps
options.doc: Adds traps to the item pool.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute des pièges à la piscine de l'article.

options.name: Floor-by-Floor Elevator Access
options.doc: Elevator access is unlocked floor-by-floor rather than all at once.
options.doc_fr: L'accès à l'ascenseur est déverrouillé au sol plutôt qu'à la fois.

options.name: Starting Games
options.doc:
This controls which games are available at the start of the game.
Vanilla gives the player Super Jumplad, Madwheels 97, and Myrmidon

options.name: Starting Roommates
options.doc: This controls how many roommates the player starts with. Default 0, maximum of 16 (all recruits).

options.name: Hide Overworld Items
options.doc: Hides the identity of overworld items until they have been picked up.
options.doc_fr: Cachez l'identité des objets du monde entier jusqu'à ce qu'ils aient été récupérés.

options.name: Rat Child Name
options.doc: This controls the rat child's name, default is 'Rat'.

options.name: Local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_fr: Force ces objets à être dans leur monde d'origine.
options.doc_html_fr: Force ces objets à être dans leur monde d'origine.

options.name: Non-local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_fr: Force ces objets à être en dehors de leur monde d'origine.
options.doc_html_fr: Force ces objets à être en dehors de leur monde d'origine.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_html: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_fr: Commencez par le montant spécifié de ces éléments. Exemple : {Bomb : 1, Flèche : 3}
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez par le montant spécifié de ces éléments. Exemple : {Bomb : 1, Flèche : 3}

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.
options.doc_fr: Commencez par les emplacements de ces éléments préremplis dans la commande ``!hint``.
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez par les emplacements de ces éléments préremplis dans la commande !hint.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.
options.doc_fr: Commencez avec ces emplacements et leur élément prérempli dans la commande ``!hint``.
options.doc_html_fr: Commencez avec ces emplacements et leur élément prérempli dans la commande !hint.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.doc_html_fr: Empêcher ces endroits d'avoir un élément important.
